role.roleTitle: Senior Project Manager, Plant Automation Retrofits

evidence.text: Project engineer, then workstream manager, on the bottling plant automation retrofit programme of a beverage group for five years, running the instrumentation and the control-panel workstreams within retrofit projects run by the programme's project managers.
evidence.notes: Candidate was workstream manager, not project manager of record.

missingEvidence: Candidate signed project charter or stage-gate submissions

evidence.text: Budget responsibility was limited to the workstream cost tracking against the allocation set by the project manager of record; no delegated spending limit was held.
evidence.notes: Candidate did not hold budget authority.

missingEvidence: Held project budget under programme's delegated limits

evidence.text: Supported the plant shutdown windows at four plants as the workstream manager on site, with the shutdown plan and the shutdown decisions held by the project manager of record and the plant manager.
evidence.notes: Candidate supported shutdowns but did not run them independently.

missingEvidence: Ran plant shutdown windows with plant managers independently

evidence.text: Planned and tracked the two workstreams under the programme's stage-gate method, producing the workstream plans, the progress reports and the stage-gate inputs that the project manager of record assembled into the gate submissions.
evidence.notes: Candidate planned workstreams but did not direct the project.

evidence.text: Work sample: the instrumentation workstream plan and progress reports for one retrofit project, the workstream risk register and the hand-over note for gate three, with the programme office's document references as a verification trail; the gate submissions carry the project manager of record's signature.
evidence.notes: Work samples show candidate's contribution but not project management authority.

missingEvidenceGaps.gap: Candidate was not project manager of record; no evidence of signing charters or stage-gate submissions.
Candidate did not hold the project budget; budget responsibility was limited to workstream cost tracking.
Candidate supported shutdowns but did not run them independently; shutdown decisions held by project manager of record.
Candidate planned workstreams but not project-level workstreams; workstreams were part of larger projects managed by others.
Candidate wrote workstream-level documents, not project-level documents.

interviewSignalRisks.text: candidate said he has been 'the senior PM in all but name' on the retrofits and that the projects 'were run by me day to day'; asked which charters or gate submissions he had signed, he said the project manager of record signed them 'because of the org chart'.
interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Ask for specific examples of project management authority and evidence of signing charters or gate submissions.

interviewSignalRisks.text: the candidate's LinkedIn title reads 'Senior Project Manager, Plant Automation'; the head of the retrofit programme wants the packet to say who was project manager of record on each project and who held the budget.
interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Ask candidate to clarify LinkedIn title and confirm if they were project manager of record.

hiringEvidencePacket.auditSummary: The materials establish the candidate's role as workstream manager supporting project managers of record, but do not establish the candidate was the project manager of record, held the budget, or ran shutdown windows independently. The LinkedIn title and recruiter comments suggest overclaiming, requiring verification.
limitations: No evidence of candidate signing charters or stage-gate submissions
No evidence of holding project budget
No evidence of running shutdown windows independently
